ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The work introduces a universal in-plane confined growth strategy for mesoporous MOF/MXene heterostructures with continuous interfacial contact and vertically accessible mesochannels, overcoming the trade-off between contact and pore accessibility. The optimized electrode achieves 163.9 Wh kg–1, excellent rate capability, and ~100% retention over 50,000 cycles, offering a generalizable design principle for mesoporous crystalline heterostructures in energy storage.
